label: One mean between two terms
subgoals: Split the endpoint gap into two equal parts
Add half the difference to the first term
Check the mean as the average of the endpoints

label: The common difference
subgoals: Count one more gap than the number of means
Divide the endpoint gap by the gap count
Step from the first term to the last

label: The later means
subgoals: Index each mean from the first term
Multiply the position by the common difference
